description:
Fold the configuration mirror of item-kind scope into the domain enum.

## Background

`KindScopeConfig` (`crates/jit/src/config.rs:811`) mirrors `item::KindScope` (`domain/item.rs:383`) with its own `FromStr`, `Deserialize` and `Serialize` (`config.rs:822-856`), converted at `item.rs:712-713`. `domain/item.rs:42-44` imports it from config. `KindScope::ISSUE_TOKEN` also spells the reserved `@/issue/` address segment (`item.rs:233,252,255,258,912`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `KindScope` is declared through the macro, and `ItemKindConfig.scope` (`config.rs:539`) is a `KindScope`.
- [hard] REQ-02: `KindScopeConfig` and its conversion are gone, and the domain no longer imports it from config.
- [hard] REQ-03: The `@/issue/` address segment has its own address-grammar constant.
- [hard] REQ-04: Item-kind declarations in this repository load unchanged.
title: Item-kind scope has one enum
